references.text: Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him, a parallel to the obedience described in Numbers 1:19
A later census on the plains of Moab, also carried out according to the Lord's command, using the same expression for counting the people
The arrival of Israel at the wilderness of Sinai, the place where the census in Numbers 1:19 took place
Moses spoke to the Levites according to the Lord's command, showing the same obedience to God's word as in Numbers 1:19
The Passover celebration in the wilderness of Sinai was carried out just as the Lord had commanded Moses, at the same location and with the same obedience
Describes how the work was done just as the Lord had commanded Moses, using the same pattern of obedience
